title: Lou Singer arrangements on 'Flow Gently, Sweet Rhythm'
summary: They did these songs on the air, not in clubs with Kirby; she did not keep the arrangements.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: This particular group of songs, so far as we're concerned, were very good but they wound up -- I don't know. Maybe they wound up in some kind of a classic directly, or something like that.
Because they never were popular, you know, except that we did them in clubs.
I liked Lou Singer's arrangments. We did do these things on the air, of course. You know, so far as using them, we used them on the air. And I did sing them in clubs.
But by this time, I wasn't appearing in clubs with Kirby. I would be appearing maybe with a
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
trio, or something like that. And we just used the piano, bass and guitar parts and whatever instrumentation is there.
I never did use those arrangments. In fact, I don't even know where those arrangements are. They got lost somewhere along with some of Kirby's stuff too.
But we did do these on the 'Flow Gently Sweet Rhythm' Show. And I did do these numbers in clubs with another group. It was another group of instruments, not the same thing.
